raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE ServiceNow Developer | Huron Consulting Private Ltd, Bengaluru, India | Dec 2024 — Present • Develop and customize ServiceNow applications across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM and SecOps based on business requirements. • Configure Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management following ITIL best practices. • Develop Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions and ACLs using JavaScript. • Use GlideRecord, GlideSystem, GlideForm and GlideAjax for server-side and client-side development. • Build Flow Designer automations, approvals, notifications, scheduled flows and reusable subflows. • Configure Service Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variables and Variable Sets. • Support CMDB, CI relationships, Discovery, Event Management and MID Server activities. • Support ITAM asset lifecycle, hardware/software assets, asset-CI relationships and data quality. • Support SecOps security incident, vulnerability and remediation workflows. • Develop REST/SOAP integrations using JSON/XML and OAuth; use Import Sets and Transform Maps for external data. • Use Update Sets and application scopes for deployment; perform testing, debugging and root-cause analysis. ServiceNow Developer / ITSM Analyst | Omega Healthcare, Bengaluru, India | Sept 2023 — Dec 2024 • Configured and supported ServiceNow ITSM processes for enterprise healthcare users and support teams. • Developed Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, UI Actions and Script Includes. • Created Flow Designer/workflow automation for approvals, notifications and request fulfillment. • Configured Service Catalog Items, Variables, Variable Sets and Record Producers. • Supported CMDB, CI relationships, asset information and ITAM lifecycle activities. • Supported security-related workflows including security incidents and vulnerability remediation. • Worked on REST integrations, JSON data exchange, ACLs, roles, Import Sets, Transform Maps and Update Sets. • Troubleshot incidents, changes, requests, integrations and application issues. ServiceNow Support Analyst | Datamatics Global Services Limited, Bengaluru, India | Aug 2022 — Aug 2023 • Supported ServiceNow ITSM operations and enterprise service requests. • Worked with incidents, requests, changes and knowledge processes following ITIL-based procedures. • Assisted with ServiceNow configuration, testing, troubleshooting, CMDB data maintenance and documentation. • Collaborated with technical teams to resolve ServiceNow-related issues and fulfill business requests.
PROJECT Healthcare Enterprise ServiceNow ITSM / ITOM / ITAM / SecOps Project Role: ServiceNow Developer Environment: ServiceNow, ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SecOps, CMDB, Discovery, Event Management, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, JavaScript, REST/SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets, Transform Maps. • Configured Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management for healthcare IT support teams. • Built Flow Designer automation for approvals, assignments, notifications and request fulfillment. • Configured Service Catalog Items, Record Producers, Order Guides, Variables and Variable Sets. • Developed Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions and ACLs. • Supported CMDB, Discovery, MID Server and Event Management for infrastructure operations. • Supported ITAM asset lifecycle, hardware/software assets and asset-CI relationships. • Supported SecOps Security Incident Response, Vulnerability Response and remediation workflows. • Developed REST/SOAP integrations and used Import Sets and Transform Maps for external data. • Performed testing, debugging, troubleshooting and deployment using Update Sets.
MOHAN KUMAR RJ | ServiceNow Developer
ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES • Configured tables, fields, forms, views, related lists, dictionary entries, users, groups and roles. • Performed requirement gathering, solution design, development, testing and production support. • Troubleshot scripting, workflow, integration, access-control and data-related issues. • Worked with application owners, infrastructure, security and business stakeholders to deliver ServiceNow solutions.
